messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you an extra day off, creating a three‑day weekend).  
(If you’re in a province or territory that observes additional holidays, you’ll want to add those separately.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 | Sunday | Yes – New Year’s Eve (Dec 31) + New Year’s Day (Jan 1) = 3‑day weekend |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Monday | Yes – Feb 19 (Sunday) + Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | Yes – Good Friday + Easter Monday (Apr 10) = 4‑day weekend |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | Yes – May 21 (Sunday) + Victoria Day (May 22) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Saturday | Yes – Canada Day (Jul 1) + Canada Day (Jul 2) = 3‑day weekend |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | Yes – Sep 3 (Sunday) + Labour Day (Sep 4) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | Yes – Oct 8 (Sunday) + Thanksgiving (Oct 9) |
| **Remembrance Day** (observed in some provinces) | Nov 11 | Monday | Yes – Nov 10 (Sunday) + Remembrance Day (Nov 11) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Monday | Yes – Dec 24 (Sunday) + Christmas Day (Dec 25) |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 | Tuesday | Yes – Boxing Day (Dec 26) + Dec 27 (Wednesday) = 4‑day weekend |

**Quick notes**

* **New Year’s Day** falls on a Sunday, so you get a 3‑day weekend (Dec 31–Jan 1).  
* **Good Friday** and **Easter Monday** together give a 4‑day weekend.  
* **Canada Day** falls on a Saturday, so you get a 3‑day weekend (Jul 1–Jul 2).  
* **Remembrance Day** is officially observed on Nov 11, but only a few provinces (e.g., Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario, Saskatchewan) observe it as a statutory holiday.  

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays or want to automate fetching them, let me know and I can help you set up an API call or a script.
